title: Head and Neck Carcinoma Clinical Research Platform for Molecular and Blood-based Biomarkers, Treatment and Outcome
official: Head and Neck Carcinoma Clinical Research Platform for Molecular and Blood-based
summary: Prospective, open, non-interventional, multi-center clinical registry study with the aim to establish a comprehensive research platform reflecting the real-world treatment landscape for recurrent/metastatic head and neck tumor patients.
conditions: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Oral Cavity
Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Oropharynx
Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Hypopharynx
Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Larynx
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 years
* Able to understand and willing to sign written informed consent
* Histologically or cytologically confirmed squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck (oral cavity, oropharynx, hypopharynx or larynx)
* Patients not amenable for curative treatment who receive palliative systemic treatment or best supportive care
* Informed consent no later than four weeks after start of first-line palliative systemic treatment. For patients receiving "best supportive care only": no later than six weeks after diagnosis/recurrence or metastatic disease

Exclusion Criteria: none
